_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 83: 24-27 June 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts seeing Gore Rising in Minnesota and praying over the Fourth of July, then that he saw Donald Duck on a boat trying to spread a virus on a Disney cruise ship going out of the port by Cape Canaveral, and that the Lord said they will try to spread a virus on a cruise ship.
mentions.quote: they will try to spread a virus on a cruise ship
mentions.falsify_match: A deliberate outbreak on a Disney ship sailing from Port Canaveral.
mentions.falsify_miss: None on a date, since none is given. Cruise ship outbreaks are common and reported routinely, so an ordinary norovirus event on that line would be available to claim; the deliberate part is what would need separate evidence.

mentions.claim_text: He says the man likes Rick and even said it publicly, that this is what the Lord is trying to warn them about ahead of time, that he said a new Watergate scandal in 2028 will come in the news and they are going to say it, that he is already saying it and embraced it saying I like Nixon, and that he would tell him his words are powerful.
mentions.quote: A new Watergate scandal in 2028 will come in the news
mentions.falsify_match: A 2028 scandal compared to Watergate in the news.
mentions.falsify_miss: No scandal. The fulfilment offered is that the man compared himself to Nixon, which is a remark rather than a scandal, and comparing oneself to a president is ordinary political speech.

mentions.claim_text: He reads from Exodus that the Lord will cause his goodness to pass in front of him and proclaim his name, that he will have mercy on whom he will have mercy and compassion on whom he will have compassion, but that you cannot see his face for no one may see him and live, and recounts Moses asking to be shown his glory.
mentions.quote: you cannot see my face for no one may see it
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: scripture read aloud, nothing claimed.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not know whether it is physical or spiritual but he sees a lady in a pit whose name is Maria and that he is getting her out of the pit, then tells anyone whose name is not Maria to receive it for themselves, saying they will lack nothing tonight.
mentions.quote: I see a lady in a pit and her name is Maria
mentions.falsify_match: A woman named Maria coming forward with a matching situation.
mentions.falsify_miss: No one does. Maria is among the most common women's names in the world, and the invitation to receive it whatever your name is removes the need for a match at all.

mentions.claim_text: He thanks everyone for coming and hopes they were refreshed, says he feels a mandate to pray and has been praying more because the Fourth of July is coming, and that he believes they will be back tomorrow and certainly Sunday, praying before the 4th.
mentions.quote: I feel a mandate to pray
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: a sign-off with nothing forecast.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has had such an urgency of praying over the Fourth of July and over President Trump a lot, covering him as he makes decisions concerning America and its finances for the Clarity Act and the Save America Act, that the Fourth of July is next week, that after that he does not know, and that he has seen events taking place in July.
mentions.quote: I've seen events taking place in July
mentions.falsify_match: Events in July matching what he saw.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Events taking place in July names nothing at all, and he says in the same breath that after the 4th he does not know. Now past due with nothing to score.

mentions.claim_text: He says that for those anointed with oil, those who take communion and those who understand Psalm 91 and Psalm 23, the death angel will pass by their house and it will not touch them, that they need to know who they are and read the Bible so the glory of the Lord will come through them and they will lay hands on the sick and they will recover and walk in the glorious anointing, and that the Lord said you can lessen it but you will not stop it.
mentions.quote: the death angel will pass by your house and it will not touch you
mentions.condition_text: if you are anointed with oil, take communion and understand Psalm 91 and 23
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an exemption conditioned on unverifiable states.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a. You can lessen it but you will not stop it is the important part: it guarantees the disaster will arrive whatever the audience does, while promising them personally that it cannot reach them.

mentions.claim_text: He says it was really dark blue and then started to affect the Supreme Court judges, that he saw red that were cowards with no pulse just idly standing by, that this concerned December and January of this year, that he saw a blue pulse coming out of the Senate and they were coming after him, and that he saw President Trump trying to fly and his wings were clipped.
mentions.quote: I saw President Trump trying to fly and his wings were clipped
mentions.falsify_match: The Senate and the courts constraining the president over that winter.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not. Wings clipped is an image without a threshold, and the Republican judges being cowards who stand idly by covers the case where the courts do nothing as well as the case where they rule against him.

mentions.claim_text: He says there was something more to seven and that he is not touching any more of it and they can pray about it themselves, then gives a word for a lady, saying she is 71 years old and was born on June 25th of 1954, and asks them to pray for her because he believes it is her health.
mentions.quote: She's 71 years old. She was born on June 25th of 1954
mentions.falsify_match: A viewer matching both the birth date and the health situation.
mentions.falsify_miss: The details do not fit anyone who comes forward. The two given here do not fit each other: someone born on 25 June 1954 turns 72 on the day this was spoken, not 71. That is checkable arithmetic, and it is the only word of knowledge in the corpus precise enough to fail on its own terms.

mentions.claim_text: He says that is what they saw and that he said Pakistan will become involved in the days ahead, that they saw this back in January, that he said he sees Pakistan beating their drum and Pakistan is getting upset, that he said Pakistan will join Iran in the days ahead, and asks why Pakistan since you never hear about Pakistan.
mentions.quote: I said, Pakistan will join Iran in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. He makes the strongest available case for it himself, that you never hear about Pakistan, which is what would make an unlikely call worth something. The January dating is checkable inside this corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He declares that as they get through July they will uncover every plot and every plan across this land concerning July, the Fourth of July and the presidency, that he sees a dark blanket of great smoke and a dark blanket of great distractions for July, and that he sees fires, repeating that they see July.
mentions.quote: A dark blanket of great distractions for July
mentions.falsify_match: Plots uncovered and major distractions dominating July.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Great distractions is satisfied by any news month, and fires in July is close to certain in America. Now past due and effectively unscoreable.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will try to clip his wings, repeating it, and that Trump, they will try to clip as far as going into January, and that he sees him.
mentions.quote: Trump, they'll try to clip as far as going into January
mentions.falsify_match: Constraints on presidential authority through to January.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. They will try covers the case where nothing succeeds, so the claim is met by opposition existing at all.
